notes: The nominated span (Part II §B, page 8) prescribes 24-hour oral and five-day written reporting when daily maximum limitation violations occur, with an empty pollutant list ('None'). Purposes A, B, and C concern applicable numeric limits and exceedance, monitoring-requirement applicability, and missing-evidence semantics respectively. Interpreting this reporting clause or its empty list does not change which limits apply, whether measurements exceed them, whether monitoring was required, or how absent or NODI results should be classified.
